description:
ROLE Software Engineer-Java and Web Technology
 The Software Engineer is assigned to a specific software solution and is responsible for writing code to meet user interface specifications. Responsibilities also include defining user needs, providing input to functional design, testing and troubleshooting.
 Required: Core Java, RCP, SQL development 
 Minimum Qualifications:
     Bachelor's degree in IT related field
     5+ years of experience with software development
     Ability to lead and mentor associates
     Strong communication skills; written and verbal
      Strong critical thinking and systematic problem solving skills
     Live or willing to relocate to the Kansas City area
 


  5+ years of experience with software development ,  Core Java, RCP, SQL development . 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
